sent_to_model:
I need to reply to Curt Hribernik at Proliance Energy, LLC about his comments on our Master Agreement. He wants a 48-hour response period for confirmations and New York law, as well as changes to the other provisions in my notes. In Defaults and Remedies he wants to remove the wording about selecting transactions and the arbitration references. We've already discussed the letter of credit, but his company hasn't provided it. Please address each provision with our decision and any reason I've given, and mention the outstanding letter. Ask for his proposed amounts for Articles 4.2 and 4.6 so I can send them to credit. Tell him I'll also send his Material Adverse Change comments to credit. For New Taxes, point him to Section 4.1 and Article 6.1. Include the confirmation period and governing law we accept, and invite questions or comments.

- Art. 8.5 Applicable Law: accept New York law.
- Appendix 1 Arbitration, Disputes to be Arbitrated: reject revisions.
- Art. 4.2 Triggering Event: credit department supplied amounts; counterparty's alternatives needed for credit review.
- Art. 2.3 Equipment and Transaction Tape: reject wording revisions.
- Appendix 1, Multiple Delivery Point Utilization (Enfolio General Provisions): reject revisions.
- Recipient: Curt Hribernik at Proliance Energy, LLC; he emailed Master Agreement comments.
- Art. 6.2 New Taxes: relevant existing provisions are Art. 6.1 and Section 4.1.
- Art. 4 Defaults and Remedies: retain 'any or', 'selected by it', and arbitration references.
- Either party may select transactions for cancellation or continuation.
- Art. 3.2 Seller's Failure to Schedule: reject wording revisions.
- Appendix 1 Enfolio General Provisions, Material Adverse Change: credit decision; his comments to be forwarded.
- Company's letter of credit outstanding; previously discussed.
- Art. 7.1: title, loss risk, indemnity, balancing: reject revisions.
- Quality standards covered under Representations and Warranties and Gas Specifications.
- Art. 4.6 Collateral Requirement/Termination Payment Threshold: credit supplied amounts; counterparty's alternatives needed for credit review.
- Art. 2.4 Confirmations: accept extending response period to 48 hours.
- Appendix 1 Enfolio General Provisions, Gas Specifications: reject revisions.
- Art. 4.4 Offset: reject revisions.

(About me: energy company contract representative. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Reply provision by provision with the supplied decisions and reasons, including accepting 48 hours for confirmations and New York governing law.
Mention the outstanding letter of credit.
Request proposed amounts for Articles 4.2 and 4.6 to forward to the credit department.
Say Material Adverse Change comments will go to credit and refer the New Taxes issue to Article 6.1 and Section 4.1.

reference.kind: a real piece of writing by a real person

source.licence_note: Enron corpus (FERC public release); HF card: unknown
